thread:
ashley: heads up — we've got a customer escalation, multiple apps reporting 500s and increased latency since the metering-override flag rollout around 10:05 UTC. dashboard spike on api-gateway latency/5xx. https://dash.redwood/apps/overview?id=api-gateway :grimacing:

ashley: minimal repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"hello"}' -> 500 with stack: 
```
Error: upstream gateway: unexpected EOF
 at handler.js:142
```

ashley: customer says billing events doubled around the same time, not sure if related. ticket #C-8241 created by support-bot. @dan @luke can you triage?

dan: on it. grabbing logs from the canary hosts now. do we know which config changed in the metering-override rollout?

ashley: config diff attached in the rollout PR, but main change is the metering-override boolean and a new per-tenant exposure header. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/3245

deploy-bot: canary rollout started by priya — service=api-router target=20% -> 60% at 2768128800

luke: looking at ingress logs — a lot of upstream 502/504s from inference-runtime when seq_len > 1024. error rate correlates with canary weight. example request id: req_8f3a2b

priya: I increased canary to 60% at 10:15 to test metering header propagation. rolled back a small typo earlier but maybe missed header mapping.

dan: quick check — the metering header change touches auth proxy and route selector. if header absent, routes fall back to default model which triggers a kernel-path incompatible variant -> timeout.

ashley: customer-facing alert: "500 errors on /v1/generate for some tenants" — they're cutting traffic. we should rollback if it's the canary.

luke: preparing rollback now. running: 
```
kubectl set image deploy/api-router api-router=api-router:v2.14.1 --namespace=prod
```

sre-oncall: confirm rollback plan and update on-call runbook. Priya, do we hold the rollout or full rollback?

priya: hold and scale back to 10% first while we validate headers. if 5xx persists at 10% then full rollback.

billing-bot: alert — billing pipeline detected duplicate metering events for tenant t-348 starting 10:07 UTC, count spike +120%

dan: running a targeted test against a repro tenant with seq_len 1200. hitting the instance directly (bypass router) returns 200. going via router returns 500. implies router/header mismatch.

luke: rollback to v2.14.0 pushed to 20% now, will tilt down to 0 over next 5m. watching errors.

ashley: support-bot posted an interim message to customer that we're investigating and throttling the rollout. ticket updated.

support-bot: message posted to ticket #C-8241: "We've detected a regression in a staged rollout. Rolling back and investigating root cause. ETA 15-30m."

priya: telemetry shows 5xx rate dropping after rollback started. still seeing a few spikes correlated with tenants that received the new header earlier.

dan: quick patch idea — add a safe fallback in auth-proxy for missing header to avoid route divergence. can push as a hotfix to canary hosts only.

luke: agree but we need to avoid making partial fixes that complicate rollback. prefer full rollback + follow-up hotfix on next deploy window.

priya: will follow that. full rollback complete at 10:35, canary weight back to 0%. monitoring.

ashley: customer updated with rollback confirmation and apology. asking for post-mortem and mitigation timeline.

billing-bot: billing backfill job queued to reconcile duplicate events.

dan: collecting logs/traces for PM. saving a capture of router config and diff: 
```
router.conf (canary): route_selector: tenant_header -> model_variant_x
router.conf (stable): route_selector: default -> model_variant_y
```

priya: postmortem draft in progress, will include repro steps, config diff, and the decision timeline. assigning owners: dan (logs/traces), luke (rollback steps), ashley (customer comms), priya (postmortem).

sre-oncall: good. next actions: 1) hold any metering-override rollouts until patch, 2) run canary regression suite against seq_len>1024 scenarios, 3) reconcile billing.

ashley: noted. closing incident channel once PM posted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
